tokens.name: crema
tokens.usage: Page background. The cream of their paper placemats by day; the night sky over the piazza in the Sera theme.

tokens.name: carta
tokens.usage: Paper panels: menu cards, the hours card, form fields, the text side of a split. Never a whole page.

tokens.name: bianco
tokens.usage: The white border of a cartolina (postcard photo) and the light stripe of the tenda. Same in both themes, like a real postcard.

tokens.name: inchiostro
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on `crema` and `carta`. The black ink of the engraved logo.

tokens.name: inchiostro-muted
tokens.usage: Dish descriptions, captions, secondary lines on `crema` and `carta`.

tokens.name: filo
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between menu items and sections. Never for controls.

tokens.name: rosso
tokens.usage: Pomodoro red, the brand colour. Full-bleed hero and poster bands, the tenda stripes, the primary button, giant headline type on `crema`. Each page gets at least one big `rosso` moment.

tokens.name: vino
tokens.usage: Deep wine red. One poster band per page at most, the footer, the menu page ground on dark. Text on it is `on-rosso`; small gold accents are `senape`.

tokens.name: rosso-text
tokens.usage: Red text and links on `crema` and `carta`: prices, the italic accent word, hover. 5.8:1 on `crema` (light), 8.3:1 (dark).

tokens.name: on-rosso
tokens.usage: Text, icons and focus rings on `rosso` and `vino` fills (5.8:1 on `rosso`).

tokens.name: cielo
tokens.usage: Summer sky blue. The holiday accent: one band or block per page (the Senza glutine section, the map, a postcard stamp). Text on it is `inchiostro`. `rosso` type on `cielo` only at 24px and larger (4.1:1).

tokens.name: senape
tokens.usage: Mustard, from their placemats and the sun on the piazza. Stamps, the francobollo, one small block on the cover, small labels on `vino`. Decorative: text on it is always the light-theme `inchiostro` #1f1915, never white.

tokens.name: on-senape
tokens.usage: Text on `senape` and on `cielo` in the light theme (9.2:1 on senape).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on `crema` and `carta`: 2px solid, 3px offset. On `rosso` and `vino` bands use `on-rosso` instead.

styles.name: display-poster
styles.usage: Giant poster type, edge to edge, on a `rosso` ground (home hero) or in `rosso` on `crema`. clamp(96px, 17vw, 260px). Once per page.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Page titles. clamp(64px, 10vw, 144px). Sentence case, one word may be italic.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section headlines, sentence case, at most one italic word in `rosso-text`. clamp(44px, 6vw, 84px).

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Card titles, postcard captions on big cards, the price of the moment.

styles.name: display-italic
styles.usage: The italic accent word inside a headline, always in `rosso-text` on light grounds or `senape` on `vino`.

styles.name: label-l
styles.usage: Menu category titles, ticket headings, the big word on a stamp. Uppercase, in `rosso-text`.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above headlines and in poster corners.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons, nav links, menu tabs. Uppercase.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: La trattoria tipica lucchese, in piazza Anfiteatro.
styles.usage: One or two intro sentences. Max 42 characters wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tortelli lucchesi casalinghi al ragù, pici cacio e pepe, la zuppa toscana.

styles.name: menu-item
styles.usage: Dish names, wine names, list items.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices, with tabular numbers, in `rosso-text`. `15 €` in Italian, `€15` in English.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: homemade tortelli from Lucca with meat sauce

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Eyebrow to headline; dish name to description.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between menu items; inside buttons (vertical); the mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Headline to lede; between buttons; card padding; the tenda scallop width is 2 of these.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Lede to buttons or content; desktop column gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile; desktop side gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop: clamp(56px, 9vh, 104px). Never more.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Fixed header height. Sections fit calc(100svh - header-h); anchors use it as scroll-margin-top.

tokens.name: tenda-h
tokens.usage: Height of the tenda (awning) edge: 32px stripes plus 24px scallops.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Bands, poster blocks, menu frames, full-bleed photos.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Cartolina photos inside their white border, form fields, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and the language switch: round like a sun lounger cushion. The only round controls.

tokens.name: radius-ellisse
tokens.usage: The ellisse: a photo cut to the oval of Piazza Anfiteatro, and round stamps.

tokens.name: shadow-cartolina
tokens.usage: Only on a cartolina (postcard photo), so it lifts off the page like a postcard on a table. Nothing else has a shadow.
